focal.rationale: matches the original run's Claude surface exactly; the only Opus-5 prior we have on this battery (median self-match 0.845, 6/15 at ceiling) was measured under it

rater.rationale: RATER = OTHER[FOCAL] flips automatically, so the public-coordinability baseline stays CROSS-FAMILY. With an Opus focal, a Claude rater would share the focal's conventions and contaminate the matching.

battery: stimuli/v3, 120 stimuli, unchanged from the GPT run

phase1.retention: top 40% / bottom 40% of A1 self-match, drop middle 20% -> 96

A2.note: FRESH draws; selection uses A2 alone

gate.rule: independent pair count >= 20 after the frozen eligibility filter
gate.if_fail: STOP. Do not run Stage C. Phase 1 still yields Opus 5's full Stage A self-coordination map over 120 stimuli.
gate.if_pass: Stage C depth set by remaining budget: $100 ceiling - phase 1 spend

phase2_provisional.rationale: Depth cut rather than stimulus cut. 82% of the GPT run's uncertainty is between-pair (tau^2=0.0157) and only 18% is Stage C sampling, so depth 24->16 widens the CI ~4.3% while cutting stimuli 120->96 would cost ~9.5% and risks falling under the 20-pair floor.

cost_basis: runs/calib_probe.json, 36 live calls on the real prompts 2026-09-10
